summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a transaction in its own shares. On June 26, 2026, the company purchased 5,000,000 ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs International at a volume-weighted average price of 109.2411 pence per share (range 108.2000-110.1000 pence). The purchases were made under an existing share buyback programme announced on January 30, 2026. Shares will be cancelled, reducing outstanding equity. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is an ordinary open-market buyback execution, not a tender offer or special situation. Watch for continued buyback activity as part of the ongoing programme.
